text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... do I really... do I absolutely... 
have to do this...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: No matter what. Come on—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Show me your "individuality"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—How did things end up like this? It all 
began, yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started when Zenno Rob Roy, 
troubled by her plain "individuality," 
confided her worries to Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
First, show me this plain personality of 
yours. With utmost seriousness, of 
course...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser jumped on board with 
it... and Cheval Grand, who had been 
listening from afar, got dragged in too!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, what'll it be? I don't care what you 
choose. If you say you won't do it, I'm 
heading home, but――

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-wait for meee! I'll do it, I'll dooo 
it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... oh yeah, stamina! Stamina's the 
one thing I'm confident in, so— I've been 
dancing longer!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, next!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Hyaawah!? Number two, I like reading 
books...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So allow me to present my favorite 
book—which would have to be *Rob Roy*. 
What makes it particularly fascinating is 
the character of Rob Roy himself, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—And so the brushstrokes are truly 
breathtaking, capturing Scotland's 
beautiful scenery... Huh?! Ah, I'm so 
sorry! How many minutes has it been?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Got it. Next!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... my u-uniqueness... well... What 
I'm good at is..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Fishing... but, I can't go fishing 
here, ugh—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
It's so admirable how Cheval-san takes her 
classes seriously. Her back is always 
straight as an arrow...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! She m-might be serious... I 
think...! U-Um... her spine is standing so 
straight...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I see—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—With this, I have seen the individuality 
of all my lost lambs. Now then, on to the 
critiques—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
They are all wonderful! Every one of them 
can rightfully be called your aesthetic— 
the finest individuality!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Knight of Wartburg, you may halt for 
now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That Herculean robustness is, in and of 
itself, a splendid talent for an 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: E-Eheheh...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And O Cradle of Heroes, your knowledge 
overflows with love, just like the grace 
of Aphrodite—!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Do you really think so...?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, O Great Crown. Your integrity 
will surely become a North Star guiding 
your path—nay, the paths of many a 
traveler!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Umm...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, exactly...! I'm sure Cheval-san's 
earnest, hardworking nature will become a 
guiding light for someone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Staying completely serious from 
start to finish might actually be pretty 
tough~.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-Is... that so? ...I hope... that's 
true...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... I feel like I've gotten some 
courage. Gimlet-san, thank you so mu—Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Every individuality is wonderful! 
There's no way one is superior or inferior 
just because it's flashy or plain!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Look at me!! This individuality—this 
aesthetic of mine!! No one can ever 
infringe upon it!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Each of you possesses your own 
individuality—your own aesthetic. Make 
that individuality your spear!! Do not 
surrender its hilt to anyone else!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying... I should stay true to my 
own individuality... to my own aesthetic?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waho, totally! It really feels like that~.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... It's true... Gimlet-san acting 
like that might actually be... kinda 
cool...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet's "Guide to Individuality" 
drew to a close amid great success.
choice_data_list:
It really made me think about my own 
individuality.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hm? —Ah. You, yeah, you're...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...There is no need to think about it. No, 
it is beyond question.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Following wherever your id leads... 
...That too may be an individuality that 
shines."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I will carve it into your eyes once more— 
just how fierce I truly am!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, become intoxicated... By this 
brilliant radiance!!
